message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Under the deal agreed in May last year, the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years", "reason": "The BBC article directly confirms the transfer of sovereignty to Mauritius and the 99-year leaseback of Diego Garcia for the military base."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Under the deal agreed in May last year, the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly confirms the transfer of sovereignty to Mauritius and the 99-year leaseback of Diego Garcia for the military base.
